title: StudioCommentSend
description: POST /lessons/:lessonId/items/:item/comments/send (2.17.0; `expectedVersion` 2.18.0): Send for changes. Without `ids` every open comment of the item (and facet) is sent. Confirmed in the app; the route is idempotent. `expectedVersion` is for a comment on a published version or an approved master: the live version the page showed.

expectedVersion.description: The live version number the page showed. Another number means the page is out of date (409 text_changed_since_preview, detail.version is the live one).
